शोफ शोफ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. श्वि; cf. शोथ),
intumescence, morbid swelling, tumefaction, bloated-
ness, flabbiness.
—शोफ-घ्नी, f. a kind of shrub
(= शाल-पर्णी); a kind of red hogweed.
—शोफ-
नाशन, अस्, ई, अम्, removing swellings; (अस्), m.
a kind of tree (= नील).
—शोफ-हृत्, त्, त्, त्, re-
moving swellings; (त्), m. the marking-nut plant.
